concepts.title: Cameron–Martin space for Wiener measure
concepts.description: The Hilbert space of absolutely continuous paths h:[0,T]→ℝᵈ with h(0)=0 and square-integrable derivative, with inner product ∫₀ᵀh′(s)·k′(s)ds.

concepts.title: Cauchy integral formula on a disk
concepts.description: If f is holomorphic on a neighborhood of a closed disk with positively oriented boundary circle C, then for z inside the disk, f(z)=(2πi)⁻¹∫_Cf(ζ)/(ζ−z)dζ. Derivatives follow by differentiating the kernel.

concepts.title: Cauchy’s integral theorem on simply connected domains
concepts.description: The integral of a holomorphic function around every closed piecewise C¹ curve in a simply connected complex domain is zero.

concepts.title: Change of variables theorem for Euclidean integrals
concepts.description: For a C¹ diffeomorphism Φ:U→V between open subsets of ℝⁿ and a nonnegative measurable or integrable f on V, ∫_Vf(y)dy=∫_Uf(Φ(x))|det DΦ(x)|dx.

concepts.title: Characteristic function of a real probability distribution
concepts.description: For a real random variable X, φ_X(t)=Eexp(itX), t∈ℝ. It is always defined and determines the law of X.

concepts.title: Uniqueness theorem for characteristic functions
concepts.description: Two Borel probability measures on ℝ have the same characteristic function if and only if they are equal.

concepts.title: Uniqueness of finite-dimensional characteristic functions
concepts.description: Two Borel probability laws on ℝᵈ agree if their characteristic functions u↦Eexp(iu·X) agree for every u∈ℝᵈ. Equivalently, equality in law of every scalar linear combination of coordinates determines the joint law.

concepts.title: Chernoff bound for sums of independent Bernoulli variables
concepts.description: If S is a sum of independent Bernoulli variables with mean μ, then for δ>0, P(S≥(1+δ)μ)≤[e^δ/(1+δ)^(1+δ)]^μ; for 0<δ<1, P(S≤(1−δ)μ)≤exp(−μδ²/2).

concepts.title: Closable nonnegative symmetric form
concepts.description: A densely defined nonnegative symmetric form E is closable if u_n→0 in H and E(u_n−u_m,u_n−u_m)→0 imply E(u_n,u_n)→0. Equivalently it has a closed extension obtained by completing its graph norm.

concepts.title: Closed symmetric form–semigroup correspondence
concepts.description: Densely defined closed nonnegative symmetric forms on a Hilbert space correspond to nonnegative self-adjoint operators and strongly continuous self-adjoint contraction semigroups T_t=exp(−tA), with E(u,v)=⟨A¹ᐟ²u,A¹ᐟ²v⟩ on D(A¹ᐟ²).

concepts.title: Closed linear operator
concepts.description: A linear map A:D(A)⊆X→Y between Banach spaces is closed if x_n→x and Ax_n→y with x_n∈D(A) imply x∈D(A) and Ax=y.

concepts.title: Closed partial order on a topological space
concepts.description: A partial order whose graph {(x,y):x≤y} is closed in the product topology. For metric spaces this is equivalent to preservation of the relation under limits of convergent pairs.

concepts.title: Closed nonnegative symmetric form on a Hilbert space
concepts.description: A nonnegative symmetric bilinear form E on a dense vector subspace D of a real Hilbert space H is closed if D is complete for the norm ‖u‖_{E,1}=(‖u‖_H²+E(u,u))¹ᐟ².

concepts.title: Compact linear operator
concepts.description: A bounded linear operator between normed spaces that maps every bounded subset to a relatively compact subset.

concepts.title: Perron theorem for compact positivity-improving self-adjoint operators
concepts.description: A nonzero compact self-adjoint nonnegative operator on L² that sends every nonzero nonnegative function to a strictly positive function has a simple largest eigenvalue and a strictly positive eigenfunction.

concepts.title: Spectral theorem for compact self-adjoint operators
concepts.description: A compact self-adjoint operator on a Hilbert space has an orthonormal basis consisting of eigenvectors together with a basis of its kernel; every nonzero eigenvalue has finite multiplicity and zero is the only possible accumulation point of nonzero eigenvalues.

concepts.title: Weak compactness of probabilities on a compact metric space
concepts.description: The Borel probability measures on a compact metric space form a compact space for weak convergence; in particular every sequence has a weakly convergent subsequence.

concepts.title: Complex line integral along a piecewise smooth path
concepts.description: For a piecewise C¹ path γ:[a,b]→ℂ and continuous f on its image, ∫_γf(z)dz=∫_a^bf(γ(t))γ′(t)dt, with real and imaginary parts integrated separately.
